::: {.ref-description}
* Alignment of layers
* Harmonization of .obs field names for batch and cell type labels
* Harmonization of .var field name for gene names
* Sanitation of gene names
* Cross-checking of genes
* Assignment of an id to the query and reference datasets
:::

### Arguments

Arguments related to the alignment of the input and reference datasets.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_reference_gene_overlap`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The minimum number of genes present in both the reference and query datasets.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `100`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--align_layers_raw_counts`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to align the query and reference layers containing raw counts.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--align_layers_lognormalized_counts`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to align the query and reference layers containing log normalized counts.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--unkown_celltype_label`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The label to assign to cells with an unknown cell type.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"Unknown"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--overwrite_existing_key`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If set to true and the layer, obs or var key already exists in the query/reference file, the key will be overwritten.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--preserve_var_index`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If set to true, the .var index of the --input and --reference datasets will be preserved.
If set to false (default behavior), the original .var index will be stored in the --output_var_index .var column and the .var index will be replaced with the sanitized & aligned gene names.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/feature_annotation/align_query_reference/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/feature_annotation/align_query_reference);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/feature_annotation/align_query_reference/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
